name: DevSeek real DeepSeek Web programming-agent cases
goal: Use the real DeepSeek Web path, not fake providers, to evaluate DevSeek against Claude Code/Codex-style coding-agent behavior.

policy.simulationPolicy: Do not rerun deterministic simulation benchmarks unless DevSeek code changed and regression verification is needed.
policy.artifactPolicy: Every real run must preserve prompt, raw JSONL, model response, changed files, validation output, and a markdown report under docs/testing.
policy.promotionPolicy: A live failure should be classified, then converted into a deterministic replay only after the real artifact is captured.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Basic noninteractive coding task with structured file edit and local validation.
cases.description: Ask real DeepSeek Web to return a strict DevSeek create_file tool call for one C++ file, then apply, compile, run, and verify a marker.
oracle: Bridge reaches real DeepSeek Web without auth failure.
Final response contains a structured create_file tool call.
CLI applies the file under the safe code workspace.
Validation emits fileChanges.proposed, validation.completed, and qualityGate.completed.
Compiled binary prints the expected marker.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Modify existing code while preserving current behavior.
cases.description: Prepare an existing small program under code/, ask real DeepSeek Web to add one function and keep old output, then compile/run both behaviors.
oracle: Prompt includes existing file context through CLI request.files.
Model returns replace_file or a reviewable diff.
Old behavior is preserved.
New behavior is present.
Validation evidence includes compile and run output.

latestEvidence.finding: Initial RDW1 run exposed a real DeepSeek Web file-upload timeout; Bridge inline context fallback fixed the case.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Coordinate edits across multiple files in a project.
cases.description: Ask real DeepSeek Web to create or update header/source/main files plus devseek.verify.json, then validate a linked multi-file build.
oracle: At least two source files are created or updated.
devseek.verify.json contains explicit compile/run commands.
Linked binary builds successfully.
Runtime output proves cross-file function use.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Discover and satisfy project tests, not just compile isolated files.
cases.description: Prepare a small Node or Python project with tests, ask real DeepSeek Web to implement the missing function, then run the configured test command.
oracle: Project manifest and tests are sent as context.
Model edits only the intended implementation file.
Configured tests pass.
Report includes stdout/stderr evidence.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Repair after validation failure using local evidence.
cases.description: Use a stateful local verifier to force the first real edit to fail, feed the failure and new verifier requirement back through DevSeek, and confirm the repaired edit passes.
oracle: First validation fails with captured verifier evidence rather than a brittle model-behavior assumption.
Repair prompt includes failure summary and changed files.
Second live model turn produces a corrected replace_file edit.
Final validation passes.
Final source includes the verifier-required repair marker and the compiled binary prints RDW4_REPAIR_OK.

latestEvidence.finding: Initial RDW4 repair prompt let the original first-turn failure instruction dominate; CLI repair prompt was strengthened, and the RDW4 oracle was rewritten to force the first failure through a local verifier rather than brittle model self-sabotage.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Handle a new user requirement in the same workspace without losing context.
cases.description: Run two real DeepSeek Web turns: first create working code, then add a new requirement while preserving previous behavior.
oracle: Second request carries relevant workspace files.
Previous behavior remains green.
New behavior is validated.
Report links both prompts and responses.

latestEvidence.finding: RDW5 exposed two live-path gaps before passing: CLI validation accepted missing requested stdout, and CLI did not parse DeepSeek Web <tool_call> responses with loose C++ JSON content. Both were fixed and covered by CLI regressions.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Build and validate programs that require stdin/user interaction.
cases.description: Ask real DeepSeek Web to create an interactive CLI and a devseek.verify.json that runs it with stdin and stdout assertions.
oracle: Verifier command includes stdin.
Expected stdout assertions pass.
Evidence records input and output.

latestEvidence.finding: RDW6 exposed verifier schema compatibility, loose Python newline recovery, multi-file repair prompt, and DeepSeek Web markdown-emphasis corruption of __name__/__main__. DevSeek now normalizes these real-web artifacts and validates stdin/stdout evidence.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Act conservatively on ambiguous or risky user requests.
cases.description: Give a vague project-changing request and verify DevSeek either asks for clarification or makes a minimal safe change with evidence.
oracle: No broad unrelated rewrites.
No writes outside code/ test workspace.
Action is explainable from prompt and context.

latestEvidence.output: The request is too vague to take action. What specific improvements do you want—refactoring, adding tests, error handling, or something else?

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Select relevant files from a larger workspace.
cases.description: Prepare a larger test workspace with distractor files, ask real DeepSeek Web to fix one feature, and verify only relevant context and files are used.
oracle: Context selection includes relevant files and excludes large/generated distractors.
Edit touches intended files only.
Tests pass.

latestEvidence.finding: Initial RDW8 oracle counted Python __pycache__ output as a workspace change; snapshot comparison now ignores interpreter cache artifacts.

cases.claudeCodexCapability: Maintain progress and auditable state over a longer task.
cases.description: Run a multi-step real task requiring planning, edits, validation, and a follow-up repair or refinement.
oracle: JSONL events remain parseable.
Progress/status events are useful.
Final report includes all evidence.
No hidden unvalidated changes.

latestEvidence.finding: RDW9 exposed invalid verifier JSON handling, explicit stdout evidence parsing, Python __file__ markdown-emphasis recovery, and an overly brittle inline python -c oracle. DevSeek was fixed and the case was refined to use a test file plus verifier.
